label: Pre-order: parent before children
subgoals: Visit the node before any of its children
Descend into the child subtrees in the fixed child order
Finish one subtree completely before starting the next

label: Post-order: children before parent
subgoals: Visit every child subtree before the node
Emit leaves first and the root last
Combine children's results when the node is reached

label: Two passes on an RC tree
section: Two passes on an RC tree
subgoals: Push delay from the root in pre-order
Decide for each quantity whether it flows up or down the tree
